_note: THE DRAG IS REAL, NOT A PROP. `isDragOver` is LibraryManager's own state
and its handler tests `dataTransfer.types.includes("Files")`, so the
probe dispatches an actual `dragenter` carrying an actual File on the
manager root. A synthetic event with an empty DataTransfer is ignored —
correctly — and forcing the state through AssetGrid's `isDragOver` prop
would have skipped the counter logic LibraryManager needs to know when the
pointer has really left rather than crossed a card boundary. Nothing about
the component is faked; the pointer is. The wait names the DROPZONE, which
exists only in this state.
